info.title: Finance Tracker — GraphQL API Tests
info.description: Every request shows the exact URL, method, headers and body to send. All requests go to the same endpoint. The body changes per operation.
info.note: Replace <JWT_TOKEN> with the accessToken returned from signIn

requests.name: Health Check
requests.description: Public — no token needed. Confirms the API is running.

body.query: { health }

requests.name: Sign Up
requests.description: Public — creates a new user account. Copy the accessToken from the response.

body.query: mutation { signUp(input: { email: "user@example.com", password: "Password123!" }) { auth { accessToken tokenType } errors } }

requests.name: Sign Up — Invalid Email
requests.description: Should return a validation error.

body.query: mutation { signUp(input: { email: "notanemail", password: "Password123!" }) { auth { accessToken } errors } }

errors: A valid email address is required.

requests.name: Sign Up — Short Password
requests.description: Should return a validation error.

body.query: mutation { signUp(input: { email: "user@example.com", password: "123" }) { auth { accessToken } errors } }

errors: Password must be at least 8 characters.

requests.name: Sign In
requests.description: Public — returns JWT. Copy the accessToken and use it in all requests below.

body.query: mutation { signIn(input: { email: "user@example.com", password: "Password123!" }) { auth { accessToken tokenType } errors } }

requests.name: Sign In — Wrong Password
requests.description: Should return an authentication error.

body.query: mutation { signIn(input: { email: "user@example.com", password: "wrongpassword" }) { auth { accessToken } errors } }

requests.name: Protected Query — No Token
requests.description: Should be rejected. No Authorization header provided.

body.query: { incomes { id amount } }

errors.message: The current user is not authorized to access this resource.

requests.name: Add Income
requests.description: Requires JWT. Adds an income record.

body.query: mutation { addIncome(input: { amount: 5000.00, source: "Salary", description: "Monthly salary", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { income { id amount source description date } errors } }

requests.name: Add Income — Negative Amount
requests.description: Should return a validation error.

body.query: mutation { addIncome(input: { amount: -100, source: "Salary", description: "", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { income { id } errors } }

requests.name: Add Income — Future Date
requests.description: Should return a validation error.

body.query: mutation { addIncome(input: { amount: 1000, source: "Bonus", description: "", date: "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z" }) { income { id } errors } }

errors: Date cannot be in the future.

requests.name: Get All Incomes
requests.description: Requires JWT. Returns all income records for the user.

body.query: { incomes { id amount source description date } }

requests.name: Add Expense
requests.description: Requires JWT. Adds an expense record.

body.query: mutation { addExpense(input: { amount: 120.50, category: "Groceries", description: "Weekly groceries", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { expense { id amount category description date } errors } }

requests.name: Add Expense — Empty Category
requests.description: Should return a validation error.

body.query: mutation { addExpense(input: { amount: 50, category: "", description: "", date: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z" }) { expense { id } errors } }

requests.name: Get All Expenses
requests.description: Requires JWT. Returns all expense records for the user.

body.query: { expenses { id amount category description date } }

requests.name: Create Savings Goal
requests.description: Requires JWT. Creates a savings goal. Copy the id for update progress.

body.query: mutation { createSavingsGoal(input: { name: "Emergency Fund", targetAmount: 10000.00, deadline: "2025-12-31T00:00:00Z" }) { savingsGoal { id name targetAmount currentAmount progress deadline } errors } }

requests.name: Update Savings Progress
requests.description: Requires JWT. Replace <SAVINGS_GOAL_ID> with the id from Create Savings Goal.

body.query: mutation { updateSavingsProgress(id: "<SAVINGS_GOAL_ID>", newAmount: 2500.00) { savingsGoal { id name currentAmount targetAmount progress } errors } }

requests.name: Update Savings Progress — Exceeds Target
requests.description: Should return a validation error.

body.query: mutation { updateSavingsProgress(id: "<SAVINGS_GOAL_ID>", newAmount: 99999.00) { savingsGoal { id } errors } }

errors: Amount cannot exceed the target amount.

requests.name: Get All Savings Goals
requests.description: Requires JWT. Returns all savings goals for the user.

body.query: { savingsGoals { id name targetAmount currentAmount progress deadline } }

requests.name: Add Loan — Owed (I borrowed)
requests.description: Requires JWT. Adds a loan I owe. Copy the id for record repayment.

body.query: mutation { addLoan(input: { counterpartyName: "John Smith", amount: 2000.00, type: Owed, description: "Personal loan from John", date: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", dueDate: "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z" }) { loan { id counterpartyName amount amountRepaid remainingBalance type isSettled } errors } }

requests.name: Add Loan — Given (I lent)
requests.description: Requires JWT. Adds a loan I gave to someone.

body.query: mutation { addLoan(input: { counterpartyName: "Sarah Jones", amount: 500.00, type: Given, description: "Lent to Sarah for rent", date: "2025-01-10T00:00:00Z", dueDate: null }) { loan { id counterpartyName amount type remainingBalance } errors } }

requests.name: Record Repayment
requests.description: Requires JWT. Replace <LOAN_ID> with the id from Add Loan.

body.query: mutation { recordRepayment(input: { loanId: "<LOAN_ID>", amount: 500.00 }) { loan { id amountRepaid remainingBalance isSettled } errors } }

requests.name: Record Repayment — Exceeds Balance
requests.description: Should return a validation error.

body.query: mutation { recordRepayment(input: { loanId: "<LOAN_ID>", amount: 999999.00 }) { loan { id } errors } }

errors: Repayment amount exceeds the remaining balance of $1,500.00.

requests.name: Get All Loans
requests.description: Requires JWT. Returns all loans for the user.

body.query: { loans { id counterpartyName amount amountRepaid remainingBalance type isSettled date dueDate } }

requests.name: Get Dashboard
requests.description: Requires JWT. Returns the full financial summary in one request.

body.query: { dashboard { totalIncome totalExpenses netBalance savingsProgress { id name targetAmount currentAmount progress } loanSummary { totalOwed totalGiven } } }
